meta.title: B's Cozy Southern Creations
meta.description: Handmade southern cozy knits and custom gifts — blankets, scarves, hats, and resin keepsakes. Perfect for holidays, festivals, teachers, babies, and market-day shopping.

custom.title: Tell us the colors. We’ll bring the cozy.
custom.text: Share who it’s for, your favorite colors, and the size you need. We’ll knit something that feels like it was always meant for them — soft pastels, garden greens, or a full southern rainbow.

contact.title: Say hello.
contact.lede: Want a custom blanket, scarf, or hat? Send a note with colors, size, and timeline — we’d love to stitch something for you.

orderForm._note: Prices for the Order & Pay page (/order/). Blankets by size ($45/$65/$85); hats, scarves, stockings $12; set $24. Change a "price" here to raise it. Items with "quote": true have no price yet (B quotes them). shippingFlat and taxRate are PLACEHOLDERS: confirm taxRate with the Georgia Dept. of Revenue. Resin (Coasters, Games, Memories) is quote-only until B sets sizes/prices: add "sizes" with "price" and remove "quote".

reviews._note: Reviews page is /feedback/. Put B's Google 'write a review' link in googleReviewUrl (leave empty to hide the Google button). To show a review on the homepage, add it to items, e.g. {"name":"Ava","city":"Perry","rating":5,"item":"Blanket","text":"So soft!"}. Only post reviews marked OK to share.
